source_locator: Official Election Results page, Mayor table (first-choice votes)
verification_note: Ed Lee received 105,298 of 190,397 votes (55.30 percent), a first-choice majority, so he won in the first round of ranked-choice voting. Francisco Herrera was second with 28,638. Read from an Internet Archive copy of the official page. The certification letter link is listed on that page but was not opened.

source_locator: RCV Results Report, Mayor, Final State (last round, run 6/27/2018)
verification_note: Mayor special election held with the June 5, 2018 primary after the death of Mayor Edwin Lee. Final ranked-choice round: London Breed 115,977 (50.55 percent, marked WINNER), Mark Leno 113,431 (49.45 percent). Read from an Internet Archive copy of the official report. The certification letter is a scanned image and was not read.

source_locator: Final Summary Report, Mayor contest, RCV first choice totals
verification_note: London Breed received 125,200 first-choice votes (70.66 percent), a majority, so she won in the first round. Ellen Lee Zhou was second with 24,667. Final summary report run November 25, 2019. The certification letter lists the Mayor ranked-choice contest. Board of Supervisors Resolution 523-19 declares Breed elected. Read from Internet Archive copies of the official files.

source_locator: Final RCV Short Report, Mayor, Round 14 (final) on page 8
verification_note: Final round (round 14): Daniel Lurie 182,364 (55.02 percent), London Breed 149,113 (44.98 percent). Official report run December 2, 2024, read from an Internet Archive copy. Director of Elections certification letter covers the election. Board of Supervisors Resolution 612-24 declares Lurie elected Mayor.
